blockers.name: DealCloud
blockers.blocker: Private-equity SaaS with no self-serve tenant; needs a customer instance plus admin-granted scopes.

blockers.name: Gladly
blockers.blocker: Enterprise-only contract; no trial org to obtain credentials from.

blockers.name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
blockers.blocker: Credit-metered sandboxes behind an existing B2C Commerce contract.

blockers.name: Sherlock
blockers.blocker: No API to wrap; a toolkit would have to shell out to the CLI or re-implement it.

blockers.name: Paygent Connect
blockers.blocker: Merchant account and underwriting required; no self-serve sandbox surfaced.

blockers.name: iPayX
blockers.blocker: Could not locate any primary documentation for this vendor.

blockers.name: PitchBook
blockers.blocker: Enterprise contract plus a separate data agreement; no developer tier at all.

blockers.name: Mermaid CLI
blockers.blocker: Nothing to authenticate against; a toolkit would wrap a local binary, not an API.

caveats.name: WhatsApp Business
caveats.blocker: Business verification gate plus per-message pricing; limited access tier until verified.

caveats.name: Aircall
caveats.blocker: Aircall does not publish which plan tiers include API access.

caveats.name: Google Ads
caveats.blocker: Approval gate for production accounts; the access model changed in Sept 2026.

caveats.name: Meta Ads
caveats.blocker: App Review plus business verification before multi-tenant use.

caveats.name: LinkedIn Ads
caveats.blocker: Discretionary partner approval; private APIs need a separate programme application.

caveats.name: Pinterest
caveats.blocker: Trial tier blocks POST /v5/pins; Standard approval is slow and discretionary.

caveats.name: Threads (Meta)
caveats.blocker: App Review and a data-deletion callback required before production.

caveats.name: Squarespace
caveats.blocker: Hard paywall: no key on lower Squarespace tiers.

caveats.name: Amazon Selling Partner
caveats.blocker: Mandatory developer-profile review; restricted roles need a live demo.

caveats.name: fanbasis
caveats.blocker: No official developer portal surfaced; best references are a vendor GitHub repo and an SDK on npm.

caveats.name: Ahrefs
caveats.blocker: Enterprise plan (listed $1,499/mo) and conflicting official eligibility statements.

caveats.name: Bright Data
caveats.blocker: KYC compliance review gates the residential network.

caveats.name: Waterfall.io
caveats.blocker: No self-serve signup; key issued after a sales conversation.

caveats.name: Neo4j
caveats.blocker: Primary interface is a Bolt driver, not REST; the management API is narrow.

caveats.name: Plaid
caveats.blocker: Production access is reviewed; sandbox alone cannot move real money data.

caveats.name: NotebookLM
caveats.blocker: Enterprise Google Cloud licence required and the RAG query endpoint developers want does not exist.

caveats.name: Otter AI
caveats.blocker: No documented public REST API; MCP is the only supported programmatic surface.

caveats.name: Consensus
caveats.blocker: REST access is request-gated; quotas depend on org plan.
